# Fold flat passenger seat latch replacement

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Apply white lithium grease to the latch components located inside the front passenger seat's foam padding. [t469]

## Tools

- [Partial] White lithium grease [t469]

## Tips & gotchas

- Look for the cable and release mechanism hidden within the foam padding after removing the back cover. [t469]
